title: Luna and the Moonlight Garden
author: Hamidreza Rostami
short_description: A girl discovers a magical garden that only appears in moonlight.
long_description: Luna loves her grandmother's garden, but she's always wondered about the Moonlight Garden from Grandma's stories. One full moon night, she sneaks outside and discovers the garden is real—and it's magical! Flowers glow, plants dance, and a tiny ladybug with a flower crown becomes her guide. But when she finds a sad, bare branch on the Heart Tree, Luna must use her belief to bring the magic back. A enchanting story about wonder, curiosity, and the power of belief.

main_characters.name: Luna
main_characters.description: A curious girl with dark curly hair and a blue nightgown. She has wide, wondering eyes and a gentle smile.

main_characters.name: Grandma
main_characters.description: Luna's grandmother with silver hair in a bun, round glasses, and a warm, kind face. She wears a cozy sweater.

main_characters.name: Ladybug
main_characters.description: A tiny ladybug with iridescent wings that shimmer like moonbeams. She wears a crown of petals.
